callGraph.callee:
definitions.stream()
                .filter(Objects::nonNull)
                .filter(definition -> definition.matches(sourceProtocol, targetProtocol))
                .filter(ProtocolConversionDefinition::isEnabledForRouting)
                .filter(definition -> definition.capability().satisfies(requirement))
                .findFirst()
                .map(definition -> ConversionRoute.of(definition, sourceProtocol, targetProtocol)).orElseThrow

nextCandidate
                .map(candidate -> FailoverDecision.retryNext(candidate, failures, "Retrying next available route candidate")).orElseGet

routeFailures.stream()
                .map(routeFailure -> Objects.requireNonNull(routeFailure, "Route failure must not be null")).toList
